commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, signal, subprocess, time
cmd=['script','-q','/dev/null','bash','scripts/run_idf.sh','-B','build/idf','-p','/dev/cu.usbserial-1130','monitor','--no-reset']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, start_new_session=True)
time.sleep(10)
os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
try:
    out,_=p.communicate(timeout=5)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL); out,_=p.communicate()
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_BEGIN')
print(out[-12000:])
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_END')
print('ROM_BOOT_MARKER', 'ESP-ROM:esp32s3' in out)
print('POWERON_MARKER', 'rst:0x1 (POWERON)' in out)
PY
